title: The fibre degree of a finite locally free morphism is locally constant
statement:
Let $f:Y\to X$ be a finite locally free morphism of schemes [def-pc-finite-locally-free], i.e. finite, flat and locally of finite presentation. For $x\in X$ with residue field $\kappa(x)$ [def-weil-residue-field] let $Y_x=Y\times_X\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(x)$ be the fibre [def-pc-fibre-product] and
$$\delta_f(x)=\dim_{\kappa(x)}\Gamma(Y_x,\mathcal O_{Y_x}).$$
Then $\delta_f(x)$ is finite for every $x\in X$, and the function $\delta_f:X\to\mathbf Z_{\ge0}$ is locally constant on the underlying topological space of $X$ (every point has an open neighbourhood on which $\delta_f$ is constant). Equivalently, $X=\coprod_{d\ge0}X_d$ with $X_d=\delta_f^{-1}(d)$ open and closed, and $f^{-1}(X_d)\to X_d$ is finite locally free of degree $d$ in the sense of [def-pc-finite-locally-free].

proof.text: For each s, the fibre morphism is finite by base change. Its map on global sections is finite by Scheme.Hom.finite_appTop. Composing with the residue field spectrum global-sections isomorphism preserves finiteness; RingHom.finite_algebraMap gives the required finite module. For the rank function r(s) = f.finrank s, Mathlib Scheme.Hom.isLocallyConstant_finrank gives local constancy. A local proved rank/fibre comparison inside the theorem identifies r(s) with delta(s), by reducing along an affine chart, expressing the morphism as Spec.map, and using Module.rankAtStalk_eq. Here fiberDegree and finrankGamma of the fibre morphism are definitionally equal.

proof.text: Let U_d be the open fibre r inverse of {d}. The locally constant rank API shows it is closed as well. Finite, flat, and locally of finite presentation restrict to every target open, giving the finite locally free restriction. The upstream fiberDegree_morphismRestrict theorem identifies the restricted fibre degree at s with f.fiberDegree at its underlying point; the local equality hEq and membership in U_d show this is d. The equality delta = r yields the specified membership equivalence.

lean.statement: theorem finiteLocallyFree_fiberDimension_isLocallyConstant {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [f.IsFiniteLocallyFree] : let δ : S → ℕ := fun s => (f.fiberToSpecResidueField s).finrankΓ (∀ s : S, Module.Finite (S.residueField s) Γ(f.fiber s, ⊤)) ∧ IsLocallyConstant δ ∧ (∀ d : ℕ, IsClopen (δ ⁻¹' {d})) ∧ (∃ U : ℕ → S.Opens, (∀ d : ℕ, ∀ s : S, s ∈ U d ↔ δ s = d) ∧ (∀ d : ℕ, (f ∣_ U d).IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfDegree d))
